opportunities.name: Bomb hybrid siege
opportunities.objective: Test bomb hybrid siege against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Phosphorus Bomb has 1.0 AP and Valkyrie's full burn 1.5 AP, supporting magic siege with Lich Bane attacks after casts. Gunblade retains AD for physical Gatling Gun and rockets; Seraph must be earned and supplies mana for repeated bombs.
opportunities.requiredState: Enemies remain in the burn and Corki can safely weave attacks.
opportunities.failure: Rocket Barrage has no documented AP term and becomes weak.
opportunities.test: Compare Q and full W burn separately from physical rockets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The older magic-rocket premise is invalid in these primary records.

opportunities.name: Crit rocket recharge bruiser
opportunities.objective: Test crit rocket recharge bruiser against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Missile Barrage charges recharge faster from champion attacks using a crit-linked source term; Essence Reaver supplies mana and a physical Spellblade packet. Hexplate buys attack uptime after R, while Shojin and Cleaver reward physical rockets and Gatling Gun.
opportunities.requiredState: Alternate champion attacks with rockets instead of only firing from range.
opportunities.failure: Low sustained attack access loses both recharge and penetration stacks.
opportunities.test: Measure rockets replenished and E armor shred through ten seconds.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Crit does not make every rocket crit; the recharge expression needs source-stat verification.

ruledOut.reason: The older magic-rocket premise is invalid in these primary records.

unknowns: Item and ability proc attribution requires a controlled current-patch test; symbolic statFormula and source flags are not runtime verification.

testPlan: Required state: Enemies remain in the burn and Corki can safely weave attacks.
Compare Q and full W burn separately from physical rockets.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Rocket Barrage has no documented AP term and becomes weak.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The older magic-rocket premise is invalid in these primary records.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Gunblade, Lich Bane, Seraph's Embrace, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
